business_summary: 111, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates an integrated online and offline platform in the healthcare market in the People's Republic of China. It operates through two segments, B2C and B2B. The company offers supply chain integration services that help pharmaceutical companies manage products through online and offline channels; product promotion, customer analytics, patient education, and brand awareness services; and marketing and channel data services. It also provides 1 Pharmacy online wholesale pharmacy that offers pharmaceutical and other health and wellness products; and 1 Medicine Marketplace online retail pharmacy that provides drugs, nutritional supplements, medical supplies and devices, personal care, and baby products. In addition, the company offers online loan application services; cloud-based inventory management services; smart procurement services, which collect pharmacies' historical purchase orders and inventory data; and Hawkeye automated salesforce tool, as well as online consultation, e-prescription, and data services. Further, its pharmacies provide drugs, including prescription and over-the-counter drugs comprising Western and Chinese medicines; nutritional supplements, such as vitamins and dietary products; contact lenses; medical supplies and devices that consists of bandages and thermometers; and personal care products that include skin care, birth control, sexual wellness, and baby products. Additionally, the company offers research and development, and consulting services; warehousing, procurement, and logistics services; and software development and information technology support services. It serves pharmacies, pharmaceutical companies, medical professionals, and marketplace sellers. The company was formerly known as New Peak Group and changed its name to 111, Inc. in April 2018. 111, Inc. was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Shanghai, the People's Republic of China.
business_summary_ko: 111, Inc.는 자회사와 함께 중국 의료 시장에서 온라인 및 오프라인 통합 플랫폼을 운영하고 있습니다. B2C와 B2B의 두 세그먼트를 통해 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 제약회사가 온라인 및 오프라인 채널을 통해 제품을 관리하는 데 도움이 되는 공급망 통합 서비스를 제공합니다. 제품 홍보, 고객 분석, 환자 교육 및 브랜드 인지도 서비스; 마케팅 및 채널 데이터 서비스. 또한 의약품 및 기타 건강 및 웰니스 제품을 제공하는 1개의 약국 온라인 도매 약국도 제공합니다. 의약품, 영양 보충제, 의료 용품 및 기기, 개인 위생용품, 유아용품을 제공하는 1 Medicine Marketplace 온라인 소매 약국. 또한 회사는 온라인 대출 신청 서비스를 제공합니다. 클라우드 기반 재고 관리 서비스; 약국의 과거 구매 주문 및 재고 데이터를 수집하는 스마트 조달 서비스; Hawkeye 자동화 영업 도구는 물론 온라인 상담, 전자 처방전 및 데이터 서비스도 제공됩니다. 또한 약국에서는 서양 및 중국 의약품으로 구성된 처방약과 일반의약품을 포함한 의약품을 제공합니다.
